positive.prompt: Reverse engineering từ implementation sang documentation

evals.prompt: Reverse engineering API endpoint code thành API specification document
evals.expected_output: API spec với endpoints, request/response schemas, business rules extracted from code
expectations: All API endpoints documented (method, path, purpose)
Business rules inferred from validation logic
Output in standard format (OpenAPI/Swagger or Markdown)

evals.prompt: Extract Business Rules từ complex business logic code (pricing, validation, state machine)
evals.expected_output: Business Rules document với all rules numbered and explained
expectations: Business Rules identified from code logic
Each rule has: condition, action, examples
State transitions documented (if state machine present)
Edge cases inferred from code branches
